moments.title: Champions League Matchday 1 Concludes
moments.blurb: The opening matchday of the UEFA Champions League group stage wraps up today with Manchester United in action, following Arsenal and Liverpool's games yesterday and Manchester City's on Tuesday.

angles.name: Matchday wrap-up
angles.copy: Champions League Matchday 1 concludes today! Did your team get off to a winning start or is there work to do? Man Utd play this evening, following Arsenal and Liverpool yesterday. #UCL

angles.name: Man Utd focus
angles.copy: Huge night for Manchester United in the Champions League tonight as Matchday 1 wraps up. Can they secure three points to kick off their European campaign?

moments.title: Ella Langley holds UK #1
